BubbleTotem.Name: Bubble Totem
BubbleTotem.Desc: Activate to create bubbles in a body of water in front of you. Consumed on use.
ConfigDuration.Name: Duration of Bubbles
ConfigDuration.Desc: Amount of in-game minutes for the bubbles to appear.
ConfigAnimated.Name: Animated Totem
ConfigAnimated.Desc: Display animated bubbles over the totem sprite.
ConfigMaxTile.Name: Max Distance of Bubbles
ConfigMaxTile.Desc: How many tiles away from the farmer should the bubbles try to spawn.
